description: Execute one connector tool once, as the agent would, and return what the third-party system answered. Use it to check a definition works before relying on it. `input` is a JSON-ENCODED STRING of the arguments, not an object. Known limitation: the result is DOUBLY STRINGIFIED - the response is {output, status} where `output` is a JSON string; parse `output`, then parse its `.body` to reach the third-party system's actual response. What this call does depends entirely on the tool being run: it can create, change or delete data in the connected system.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

input.description: Arguments as a JSON-encoded string, e.g. '{"order_id":"123"}'. Defaults to an empty object.

name: mba_run_connector_tool
title: Run a connector tool
